resumen: Two workouts, A and B, alternated three days a week. Every session trains legs, pushing and pulling, so each muscle group is worked about twice a week.
matices: Three days a week alternating A and B gives an A-B-A week followed by a B-A-B week. It is the simplest way to train each muscle twice a week, which reviews link to more growth than once a week; between two and three times, the difference is no longer clear. The rep ranges are a guide: muscle growth happens across a wide range of loads as long as sets are taken close to failure.
